title: Fix admin dashboard permissions for saving edits and images

requirements.summary: Ensure admin authentication state properly authorizes backend write operations for Nakshatra updates and image replacements
acceptanceCriteria: Passcode authentication grants full write permissions for Nakshatra operations
Image upload and replacement operations succeed when admin is authenticated
Authorization errors are prevented for all admin write operations

file_operations.description: Review and ensure the passcode authentication hook properly stores and synchronizes admin authentication state across components. Verify that isAuthenticated correctly reflects the admin status needed for backend authorization.

Ensure the backend actor is properly configured to include admin authentication credentials when making write operations. Verify that the actor instance passes the necessary authorization context for replaceNakshatraImage and updateNakshatra calls.

requirements.summary: Verify AdminEditPage form successfully submits Nakshatra data edits and image updates without permission errors
acceptanceCriteria: Save button on AdminEditPage successfully commits all changes
Image uploads complete without authorization errors
Success toast confirmation appears after successful saves
Updated data and images are immediately reflected in the admin dashboard

file_operations.description: Review the form submission logic to ensure it properly calls both updateNakshatra and replaceNakshatraImage with the authenticated context. Verify error handling displays the specific 'only administrators can replace Nakshatra images' error to users. Ensure the mutation hook from useNakshatraMutations is correctly invoked with all required parameters.

Review the mutation hook to ensure it properly handles both Nakshatra data updates and image replacements in sequence. Verify that authentication state is checked before calling backend methods. Add error handling that distinguishes between authorization errors and other failures. Ensure the mutation invalidates the query cache on success to immediately reflect changes.

Verify the image upload component properly converts files to Uint8Array format required by the backend. Ensure the component passes the image data correctly to the parent form without loss of authentication context.
